title: Development of Implosions of Solutions to the Three-Dimensional Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: A fundamental open problem in the theory of the multidimensional compressible Navier-Stokes equations is whether smooth solutions can develop singularities in finite time. For constant viscosity coefficients, recent remarkable results show that there exist smooth initial data for which the corresponding smooth solutions of the barotropic flow undergo finite-time implosion at the origin, with the density blowing up to infinity.
